text: Added Added Code Mode, an experimental opt-in in which Claude writes JavaScript to call its tools; see https://code.claude.com/docs/en/code-mode to turn it on, or to turn it off for an organization Added engines["claude-code"] to plugin.json: plugins outside their stated Claude Code version range are not installed, updated or loaded, and install and update pick the newest version that fits Added type checking of a plugin's TypeScript hooks module to claude plugin validate; each finding is a warning, and --strict fails on it Added to claude plugin validate the $ nouns a mod's engine.create hook adds, withholds or replaces Added support for CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_MODEL in managed settings for Claude Desktop sessions on third-party providers (takes effect once Claude Desktop includes this version) Added an options menu (stop, switch to usage credits, upgrade) when a model needs usage credits that are turned off or used up Added a progress heartbeat every 30 seconds while hooks run long in claude -p and SDK sessions, so a host such as Claude Desktop won't end the turn as hung (once it includes this version) Added .docx support to Artifact tool asset uploads Added a /diff to close hint to the diff panel, and the keys that focus and close a panel to the ? shortcut guide Added a start-up warning for Bash allow rules with a * in a variable's value, such as Bash(PORT=* npm run dev) Added a warning when a plugin's language server can't start, naming the server and what to check Added a one-time startup notice naming CLAUDE_CODE_PERFORCE_MODE when Perforce settings are found and the mode is off Added CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_AGENT_PROGRESS_SUMMARIES (available since 2.1.318): set it to 1 to turn off subagent progress summaries and the requests that write them (anthropics/claude-code#86879) Added CLAUDE_CODE_RESUME_HINT_COMMAND, which a program that starts Claude Code can set to have the exit hint name its own resume command Added unsetOptionCount to the claude plugin install --json result: how many userConfig options are not yet set Added isPromptCovered to the props a mod's pane is drawn with, telling it when a dialog or a field above the prompt covers the prompt [VSCode] Added a Claude Code trust prompt before the first session in a folder you haven't trusted; declining leaves the folder's settings and MCP servers unused [VSCode] Added the live output of a running Bash or PowerShell command to the chat, under the command's card [Claude Code on the web] Added a failure notification when a scheduled task's run can't start because its settings require a sandbox that isn't available where it runs [Claude Code on the web] Added the No repository option to the repository picker for new sessions on a self-hosted environment [Claude Code on the web] Added a warning to a cloud session's Delete dialog when deleting it will pause scheduled tasks that run in that session [Remote Control] Added a Try again button to the error shown when the computer running your session is signed out of Claude Code [Claude Tag] Added Claude Tag sessions started in Slack to the Compliance API on Enterprise plans, in beta: list the sessions and read their transcripts [Claude Tag] Added a confirmation step when an admin turns off Claude Tag for the organization, with a dialog that says what stops [Claude Tag] Added a Retry button to a Slack channel's Configure page for when its settings fail to load [Claude Tag] Added a Scope filter to the Network events tab of Claude Tag's Activity page, so admins can download one scope's events instead of the whole organization's [Code Review] Added a Download CSV button to Code Review admin settings: export review costs per repository by month, week or day, for one repository, one GitHub organization or all Changed Self-hosted runner: Reverted the exit code of an on-demand runner whose work order was superseded to 1; 2.1.321 and 2.1.322 had changed it to 0 Changed /security-review to ask before Claude runs it, and skills' inline git commands to stop in bare-repository worktrees and similar folders until you allow them, outside auto mode and bypass Changed how many messages each of your sessions on the same machine can send the others without a prompt from you, from about 20 to 100,000 Changed the number of messages a Claude Desktop Code tab session can send to your other sessions before it waits for you to type again from 20 to 100,000 Changed organization settings and policy requests to no longer use a proxy set only by ALL_PROXY; set HTTPS_PROXY if your network needs a proxy for them Changed the context window assumed for a model ID that Claude Code doesn't recognize from 200K to 1M; use /autocompact to compact earlier, or CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_1M_CONTEXT=1 to keep 200K Changed sessions on other vendors' models with a smaller window: once full, they can fail every turn until /clear, so set CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_1M_CONTEXT=1 before they fill Changed Claude Code's own ripgrep and most internal git commands to run without most of its sign-in tokens and API keys, so a credential helper or hook under such a git command no longer finds them Changed MCP_SDK_GENERATION=v1 to run the v2 MCP client in a compatibility mode (earlier handshake, relaxed OAuth sign-in checks), because the v1 MCP client is removed Changed the tool Claude uses to finish an MCP server sign-in so that it asks you to confirm, even in bypass and auto modes; where nobody can be asked, such as in dontAsk mode, use /mcp Self-hosted runner: Changed a session at a connector's approval prompt or sign-in inside a running tool to be released as paused at the idle or lifetime limit; a late answer resumes from a fresh clone Changed artifact updates to ask first, even under an allow rule, when people outside your organization can see the artifact or Claude can't check who can Changed glab config set without --global or --host, and glab config edit --local, to fail read-only inside the Bash sandbox; run them outside it Changed the Bash sandbox on macOS, Linux and WSL to ignore write access granted through a symlink in a writable folder that leads elsewhere or to a missing path; grant the real path instead Changed "don't ask again" so an allow rule that looks like it holds a secret, or would be saved to a settings.local.json that git tracks, lasts for the session only and isn't saved Changed the sandbox on macOS and Linux: git worktree add, move and remove now fail read-only, as do commits in a worktree the session wasn't started in or given, even one inside the project Changed start-up to stop when a --settings file isn't valid JSON and has a sandbox key, even one that turns the sandbox off Changed what happens when a tool's permission check fails with an error after a PreToolUse hook returned "allow": Claude Code now decides the call as if no hook had answered Changed what happens when a tool's permission check fails on input that a PermissionRequest hook rewrote: Claude Code now asks again, or refuses the call where nobody can answer Changed the GitLab merge request badge to show only for the repository a sandboxed session opened in Changed the claude mcp add --help example to a local command Changed mods: a *, namespace or negated hook on engine.create now only observes. To add or withhold a $ noun, hook engine.create by name Changed claude plugin validate to fail a mod whose engine.create hook isn't written in the one accepted form; installed mods keep loading Changed marketplace and plugin installs to fail when a git submodule isn't on the commit its repository records Changed project (.mcp.json) MCP server approvals to match the server's exact name; an approval entry written in another spelling now asks again Changed self-hosted runners under --trust-workspace false and VS Code sessions in an untrusted folder: the repository's settings can no longer disable your hooks or turn plugins on or off Changed tool.list plugin hooks so the tools they add or remove apply to the model and every agent Changed claude plugin install and /plugin to show a warning instead of success when a plugin's install command writes to stderr Changed claude.ai chats and Cowork tasks to check a plugin file for secret keys before sending it, and to ask first if it may hold one Changed claude rm and the agents view to say a session is removed from the list, not deleted; claude rm help says the conversation is kept and claude --resume lists it Changed /stickers to say that the sticker pack is all claimed for now, instead of opening a page in the browser Changed a managed settings policyHelper to no longer take environment variables from user or --settings files; set what it needs in managed env or the launching shell Changed a /skill or @file typed between two files picked in claude.ai or the desktop app, or after a picked file and a link, to no longer take effect Changed split-pane agent teammates to check that requests come from their team lead: one that outlives its lead has its asks refused, and plan approvals must be re-sent after /clear or /resume Changed worktree creation to refuse checkouts whose .git folders are links or hold hard links, such as git-new-workdir layouts and cp -al copies; use a plain clone Changed what Claude is told after safeguards stop a forked skill or a workflow agent: retry with a narrower prompt or tell you, instead of doing the work itself Changed browser tool calls (Claude in Chrome, the desktop browser pane) to refuse some escaped or JSON-text inputs and tell Claude how to respell them Changed workflows so that a prompt an app marks as not typed no longer reaches their agents as your request Changed computer use on macOS to refuse key chords that hold Space with Control or Option, and more system shortcuts that need your grant Changed first-run setup in Terminal.app to name the "Use Option as Meta key" setting, what Option stops typing, and how to undo it before you agree Changed the maximum of CLAUDE_CODE_OVERLOADED_RETRY_MAX_DELAY_MS from 64000 to 300000 Changed workflows in the desktop app's Code tab to pause at a usage limit and continue after it resets Changed the spend limit and 1M context errors, and /usage-credits, in cloud sessions and under Remote Control: they no longer give a web address Changed which MCP servers are reported by name in OpenTelemetry exports to follow the current connector directory Changed /logout in a background session, which had no effect: it now signs out every session on the computer, deletes stored MCP logins and plugin secrets, and ends the session, as in a terminal macOS: Changed the Bash sandbox so lsof and similar tools may show less about processes a command did not start Changed cloud scheduled tasks: a PostToolUse hook from your own settings can no longer replace the plan in ExitPlanMode's result Changed CLAUDE_AUTOCOMPACT_PCT_OVERRIDE in Anthropic-hosted cloud sessions to stop applying to auto-memory extraction and, in some sessions, to /btw; the main conversation still follows it Removed the subagentStatusLine setting: subagent rows always use the default look, and settings files that still hold the key load as before Deprecated a plugin's agent setting: it still applies, and now warns at startup, in claude plugin list and in claude plugin validate [VSCode] Changed opening a Claude Code on the web session in a folder where Claude Code's sandbox is on: the extension no longer switches to the session's branch for you, and the dialog says why
